notes: ACCESS: Direct requests.get and the assigned URL (containerstore.com/home-decor) both hit a PerimeterX captcha wall (px-captcha, 307->denied page), as did /site-map.xml, r.jina.ai, and translate.goog. curl_cffi with Chrome-family impersonation (chrome131/chrome124/chrome120/chrome116) against the real category paths (/s/<dept>/<slug>/12...) succeeded consistently when calls were paced ~4s apart with a fresh profile each time; the same profile hammered repeatedly got reblocked, so profiles/timing were rotated per request. Firefox profiles and iOS Safari profiles were blocked; Chrome desktop profiles were the winning route. SITE STRUCTURE: containerstore.com/home-decor is not a resolvable path (renders an empty-query search/404 shell); the real 'Decor' department landing page is /s/home-decor/1 (categoryId 92358, totalCount 526 across 9 sub-nodes: Air Quality, Bedding Essentials, Decorative Bins & Baskets, Decorative Objects & Vases, Decorative Shelving & Furniture, Frames & Photobooks, Home Fragrances, Mirrors, Pillows & Throws, plus a Clearance cross-listing). Container Store's core business is organization/storage, confirmed here: Decorative Bins & Baskets (166 total) is 90% Household Storage per its own Product Type facet (149/166); Decorative Shelving & Furniture (91) is furniture/storage-only per the same facet (no Home Accents & Decor bucket present) -> both excluded entirely. Home Fragrances and Pillows & Throws excluded per standing rules (fragrance/textile). Air Quality excluded (appliances). VERIFICATION: every extracted node is a single-page listing (lastPage:1) where the rendered pageRange, the JSON totalCount, and a direct count of enumerated product IDs in the page's products[] array all agreed exactly -- strongest available exhaustion check. MIXED ROLL-UP DROPPED: Decorative Objects & Vases' 'Home Accents & Decor' Product Type facet (30 items, its finest available granularity, no deeper facet exists) mixed ~10 clocks + ~9 vases/planters + 3 misc decor items with 8 Holiday items (Christmas tree stand, wreath hangers, pre-lit garland/wreath/swag) with no separate URL for a holiday-free subset -- dropped whole node per the Candles precedent (no clean listing for the qualifying subset = drop, don't hand-tally a synthetic count). This is a real, acknowledged coverage gap: genuine clock and vase/planter products exist at this site but could not be reported with an exact, site-sourced, non-holiday qty. Decorative Bins & Baskets' own 'Home Accents & Decor' facet (2 items: 1 decorative bowl + 1 laundry basket) was similarly too small/mixed and dropped. Frames & Photobooks' 'Home Accents & Decor' facet (11 of 13) was KEPT because its only contamination is 2 digital photo frames plus 1 book already excluded by the facet itself (tagged Office Supplies) -- no hard-excluded category (Holiday/fragrance/textile/etc.) present, so the site-reported total of 11 for that exact URL stands. RULE 0 GAIN: containerstore.com/s/bath/makeup-organizers-mirrors/12 (85 total, under the 'Bath' department, mixed with cabinet/countertop organizers) filtered to its 'Home Accents & Decor' Product Type facet yielded 21 genuine vanity/makeup/LED/wall-mounted/shower mirrors (Zadro, simplehuman, Brabantia) -- a room-word (Bath) + mixed-node (Makeup Organizers & Mirrors) combination that a pre-Rule-0 pass would have skipped outright. That is the single biggest yield in this extraction. No standalone Lighting, Wall Decor, or Clocks department exists anywhere in the site's mega-nav (confirmed against the full nav link dump) -- the Lighting and Wall Decor rows below are both Product Type facet slices of Decorative Objects & Vases, the only place lighting/wall-decor products live on this site.
